purpose: Deterministik epistemik holat boshqaruvi va gallyutsinatsiyani nolga tushirish
responsibilities: Da'volarni ichki epistemik grafikda saqlash va kuzatish
Holat o'tishlarining (State Transitions) invariantlarini majburiy ta'minlash
Runtime uchun mashina o'qiy oladigan so'rov interfeysini taqdim etish

guarantees.zero_unsubstantiated_promotion: Level 3+ dalilsiz hech bir da'vo VERIFIED_FACT holatiga o'tmaydi
guarantees.deterministic_demotion: Raddiy dalil kelganda holat DARHOL INVALIDATED ga tushadi
guarantees.isolation: Tashqi taqdimot formatlash xatolari ichki epistemik holatga ta'sir qilmaydi

failure_modes: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Dalil darajasi o'tish talabiga yetmaydi
CYCLIC_INFERENCE: Da'vo o'z-o'ziga bog'liq mantiqiy xulosaga tayanmoqda
